need: Feedback-aware frontend skills must preserve the semantic rule that an unchecked checkbox resting on a surface uses the surface default background, and must retain each session's accepted and rejected behavior for later runtime or Grammar upgrades.
negativeBoundary: Do not hard-code authentication-page colors, persist raw transcripts or credentials, or treat recording feedback as authority to publish a Grammar change.
acceptanceCriteria: The unchecked remember-login checkbox resolves to the semantic default background on the authentication surface.
Focused component tests and real-browser proof cover unchecked, checked and focus-visible behavior without losing contrast.
Every feedback-aware frontend skill records a stable .claude/requests ledger row before later source work.
Every ledger row contains explicit non-empty accepts and rejects arrays and a stable evidence fingerprint.

accepts: An unchecked checkbox on a surface uses the semantic default background.
rejects: An unchecked checkbox renders as a detached white control against the surrounding surface.
